ops-announce-bot: Heads-up: Scheduled maintenance for KV-cache compaction (us-east1) on 2026-04-02 01:00-02:30 UTC. Minimal impact expected (brief higher embedding latency possible). Posting preflight notice and customer copy for review.

maria: Thanks — flagging a vendor-backed migration in the same region. Can we slide to 01:30-03:00 to avoid overlap?

paul: Prefer to keep earlier window if possible to limit overnight overlap globally. If we must shift, suggest 01:15-02:15 instead of 01:30-03:00 (shorter). Thoughts?

sarah: Customer-facing copy (short):
```
Planned maintenance: We will perform KV cache compaction in us-east1 on 2026-04-02. Window: 01:00–02:30 UTC (may be adjusted). You may experience brief increases in embedding latency or transient 429s for targeted endpoints. No data loss expected.
We will post updates to our status page and notify affected accounts directly.
```

sam: I can route this to Dedicated customers in us-east1 and to anyone with webhooks in that region. Recommend adding a line about contacting support if customers see persistent errors.

maria: Good call. Handoff plan: I'll be primary oncall for the window, @paul is backup. I will join the preflight call 30 minutes prior. Quick checklist for whoever is oncall:
- Confirm statuspage draft posted 45m before.
- Validate monitoring alerts for kv-eviction / high-rt tokens.
- Run smoke tests for embeddings on a few sample tenants.
- Have rollback playbook open and a GPU node ready to re-route traffic if needed.

paul: Runbook updated (link in eng-oncall thread). I'll stand by for the preflight and be in the bridge if we see >5% error increase. :thumbsup:

ops-announce-bot: Statuspage draft (please review):
```
Title: Planned maintenance — KV cache compaction (us-east1)
Start: 2026-04-02 01:00 UTC
End: 2026-04-02 02:30 UTC (approx)
Impact: Briefly elevated latency for embeddings and possible transient rate-limiting on a subset of hosts.
Updates: We'll post start/complete notices and provide a post-maint summary.
```

sarah: Customer email snippet (to be sent to affected accounts):
```
Subject: Notice: Planned maintenance in us-east1 (2026-04-02)
Hi <Customer>,
We will perform a maintenance operation that may cause short-lived increases in embedding latency or transient errors for requests routed to us-east1. The work is scheduled for 01:00–02:30 UTC on 2026-04-02. Our team will monitor health and post updates to https://status.redwood.example. If you rely on strict latency SLAs during that window, reply and we can discuss options (regional routing or temporary capacity increase).
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Ops
```

sam: I'll queue the email and include the support contact. Also will add a Zendesk tag so we can quickly filter any tickets generated during the window.

maria: Marking final decision: keep 01:00–02:30 UTC. Paul — if vendor migration overlaps, coordinate on-call escalation policy. I'll update the statuspage 45m prior and post a completion note after verification.

paul: Acknowledged. I'll be on the bridge and own rollback if we see sustained errors. See you on preflight in 30.

ops-announce-bot: Final: scheduled maintenance notice set for 2026-04-02 01:00 UTC. Please use this thread for last-minute changes and copy approvals.
